register_param_group_constructor: register a parameter group constructor function in the PARAM_GROUP_CONSTRUCTOR_REGISTRY by name
get_param_group_constructor: get a registered parameter group constructor function by its name from the registry
create_duplicate_registration: create a duplicate registration for a parameter group constructor name and verify it raises ValueError
test_registry_lookup: test the registry lookup for a parameter group constructor that is not registered and verify it raises AssertionError
summarize_registry_pattern: summarize the registry pattern used for registering and retrieving parameter group constructor functions
